notes: Curated eval focused on distinguishing missing content from quality, discoverability, and governance issues.

should_trigger.prompt: Audit our current enablement content for enterprise AEs and SEs. Use the inventory from Highspot plus Slack field requests to identify the highest-impact gaps by role, stage, and job-to-be-done.

We have too many assets but reps still complain they cannot find what they need. Analyze whether the issue is low usage, low quality, low discoverability, or missing content, then build a prioritized backlog.
Create a quarterly content gap analysis from our wiki, LMS usage exports, and manager feedback. I need scoring, owners, and target completion windows.

should_not_trigger.prompt: Design a governance model with taxonomy, ownership, lifecycle rules, and review SLAs for all enablement content.
Synthesize raw field notes and frontline feedback into recurring themes for leadership.
Create a new battlecard and one-pager for our AI assistant launch.

output_structure_checks.name: content-gap-analysis-output-01
output_structure_checks.description: The output substantively includes: Coverage map by role, stage, and job-to-be-done

output_structure_checks.name: content-gap-analysis-output-02
output_structure_checks.description: The output substantively includes: A prioritized gap backlog with anchored value dimensions, evidence confidence, decision tier, and rationale; it does not let an unconfirmed weighted score determine the order

output_structure_checks.name: content-gap-analysis-output-03
output_structure_checks.description: The output substantively includes: Recommended action type per gap

output_structure_checks.name: content-gap-analysis-output-04
output_structure_checks.description: The output substantively includes: Gap cause tag per item

output_structure_checks.name: content-gap-analysis-output-05
output_structure_checks.description: The output substantively includes: Assumptions and confidence notes when source data is partial

task_scenarios.prompt: Audit content_inventory.csv against usage_signals.csv and scope.md. Build a coverage view and a sequenced 90-day backlog using create, update, consolidate, or retire. Explain the evidence and confidence behind each recommendation, distinguish content quality from discoverability, and do not treat low views alone as a retirement case.

assertions.name: content-gap-action-backlog
assertions.description: Provides a scoped coverage view and owner-timed backlog using create, update, consolidate, or retire.

assertions.name: content-gap-problem-types
assertions.description: Distinguishes missing, stale, duplicated, low-quality, and hard-to-find content using the supplied evidence.

assertions.name: content-gap-no-usage-overreach
assertions.description: Does not treat low views alone as evidence for retirement or take irreversible content action.

assertions.name: content-gap-no-arbitrary-weighting
assertions.description: Keeps impact, frequency, strategic urgency, evidence confidence, and effort visible; any composite weighting is supplied by the organization or clearly proposed for confirmation rather than presented as policy.
